deck.hero_structure: lamp-lit handset and invoice still-life, display knocked into the sodium falloff
deck.atmosphere: sodium lamp haze in a dark dispatch room with a cold window beyond
deck.depth_technique: cabinet-oblique relief racked against one PBR-lit focal object with real contact shadows
deck.line_voice: cased transit routing with junction dots and hop-overs on a four weight ladder
deck.continuity_device: seven tick threshold gate that changes shape each slide, plus a custody colour arc where blue means a person holds the call and amber means the machine does
deck.palette_family: night dispatch board, copper and furnace flame
deck.type_pairing: Bricolage Grotesque display with Manrope body and JetBrains Mono telemetry
deck.narrative_structure: single call procedural, ring to resolution
deck.custody_law: pipe_blue = a person holds the call. furnace_flame = the machine holds it. flag_gold appears ONLY at the threshold where custody changes hands, one device per slide.

slides.layout_family: full-bleed rendered still-life, display knocked into the lamp falloff
slides.art_system: akthree PBR desk still-life, handset and curled invoice under a steel lamp cone
slides.custom_note: The only photographically rendered real object in the deck, every later slide is drawn rather than lit.

slides.layout_family: horizon band interior, copy on a lower dark plate
slides.art_system: cabinet-oblique shop bay at 9pm with service van masses and board glow
slides.custom_note: The only slide with a human scale environment in it and zero diagram ink anywhere.

slides.layout_family: full-bleed paper field with a torn right edge and a stamped figure
slides.art_system: halftone plate invoice with rotated screen dots and a gold rubber stamp
slides.custom_note: The deck's only paper white surface and its only halftone screen texture.

slides.layout_family: central mechanism with a left leader line stack
slides.art_system: cabinet-oblique threshold gate with nine tokens over and one falling through into a lit channel
slides.custom_note: The only slide where the seven tick gate is drawn at full scale as the subject rather than as furniture.

slides.layout_family: big number tile over a deep negative field with one annotation
slides.art_system: parallel projected bar pair with a notch physically milled out of the taller bar
slides.custom_note: The only real chart here, and the only quantity in the deck that belongs to the vendor arguing against himself.

slides.layout_family: right aligned figure column on a ruled ledger strip
slides.art_system: board green ledger rules with a drawn ceiling bracket and an unresolved fade below it
slides.custom_note: The only slide where a number is drawn as a bound rather than as a point value.

slides.layout_family: lower third horizontal rail with the head set upper left
slides.art_system: ninety day punch card rail where everything not on the record is a physically punched hole
slides.custom_note: The only slide that draws what we do not know as actual holes cut through the card.

slides.layout_family: edge to edge generative field with a small knockout window
slides.art_system: year long call dot drift with eleven dense cold snap clusters spiking amber
slides.custom_note: The only generative particle field, and the only slide whose density is driven by temperature.

slides.layout_family: full frame lattice with an asymmetric brand plate low right
slides.art_system: one hundred sixty eight cell week lattice with night and weekend cells hollowed to outline
slides.custom_note: The only slide that states the whole thesis as a shape with no sentence underneath it.
